subject.title: improve(agents): exact web_fetch output contract with cleaned result shape

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally remove `wrappedLength` and the flat `fullOutputPath`/`spilledChars`/`spillTruncated` fields from the model-facing `web_fetch` contract in favor of `length` and nested `spill` without a compatibility path?
rationale: This is an intentional model-facing compatibility decision rather than a mechanically determined refactor; repository policy favors one canonical model-tool contract, but maintainers must decide whether existing consumers require an explicit transition.

options.title: Approve the canonical cleanup
options.body: Keep the closed result schema and nested `spill` contract, contingent on live redacted proof of the changed runtime behavior.

options.title: Preserve a transition contract
options.body: Retain or document a narrowly scoped compatibility path for the removed result fields if maintainers identify supported consumers that require it.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the closed result schema and nested `spill` contract, contingent on live redacted proof of the changed runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the current changed-surface author; a maintainer should make the final compatibility decision.
